Every key the app answers to, on each platform.

Press Ctrl+S (Cmd+S on a Mac) to save, or see Saving and opening.

Saving and opening

KeyDoes
Ctrl+SSaves the diagram
Ctrl+OOpens a saved diagram

Saving and opening

  1. Click Save as.
  2. Pick CSV > Fields.

The canvas

  • Right-drag pans.
  • The wheel zooms:
    • in with a pinch out,
    • out with a pinch in.
